messages.subject: GCC Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear BWP Dubai Team,

Your Middle East executive-search work across power, utilities, renewable energy, transport and infrastructure aligns with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where major projects require regulatory coordination, institutional trust and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
